agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.1: export a private archive first (Settings > Download private archive, or rer export --output exports/spool.rer with local dev stopped). In a checkout of main run git pull; in a checkout of an earlier tag run git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.6.0. Then rer dev locally, or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. Three migrations apply (0054_release_resolution_dist through 0056_import_door_archives, 56 total): 0054 rebuilds issue_resolutions keeping every row and marks retained Sentry events that had no dist; 0055 and 0056 add tables. Existing projects, evidence, triage states, grouping rules, inbound filters, alert rules and project keys are preserved. Keep the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Earlier upgrades apply the migrations described in CHANGELOG.md. Archives made by 0.5.1 or earlier, including ones with an empty safe audit payload, restore only into an empty installation. The application pins rer 0.2.72. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.6.0 lets you resolve an issue in the next release or in a named release, beside plain and current-release Resolve, so a fix that ships later reopens only on a later release; Sentry events with no dist stay distinct from an explicit dist. A new Needs attention view tracks alert sends that stall, alerts left unacknowledged for a day, missed deployment deadlines and expired fix leases, and an optional alternate destination gets one notice for each, never a storm. Sentry SDK events now keep their whole exception chain, frames with source context and local variables (secret names masked), tags, contexts and request data. Archives with an empty audit history and archives written by 0.5.1 restore into a fresh installation, and large Sentry organization imports run in bounded steps (rer 0.2.72). Upgrading from 0.5.1 applies three migrations and keeps existing data; back up first. The release gate created a project, sent a real error through the documented Node SDK, saw it grouped, resolved it and watched the next release reopen it, locally at desktop and phone widths and on a fresh Cloudflare deployment with real sign-in, new-issue and regression emails; it also upgraded a populated 0.5.1 installation in place with every row kept and restored two 0.5.1 archives carrying a platform migration ledger, one with an empty audit history. Known issue: a retry right after a cut-off hosted restore is refused for up to five minutes. No Sentry feature parity, Bugsnag or Rollbar support is claimed, and this app release does not publish the SDK. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/spool-issue-page-1600.png
